title: kb_mcp sse_messages splits an SSE data line at U+2028, U+2029 and U+0085, so docs_search drops the reply
goal: kb_mcp.sse_messages splits an SSE body only at CR LF, CR and LF, so a JSON-RPC reply whose text holds U+2028, U+2029 or U+0085 unescaped is parsed and docs_search and docs_fetch return it

run:
import sys,json; sys.path.insert(0,'_tools'); import kb_mcp; m={'jsonrpc':'2.0','id':1,'result':{'content':[{'type':'text','text':'a b'}]}}; sys.exit(0 if kb_mcp.sse_messages('event: message
data: '+json.dumps(m,ensure_ascii=False)+'

')==[m] else 1)
